{{Top|leg}}
A '''Fire Direction Center (FDC)''' was a military facility used for directing [[Artillery/Legends|artillery]] barrages at certain targets.

==History==
One such center was utilized during the [[Battle of Praesitlyn]] in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]] by the [[Sons and Daughters of Freedom]], in conjunction with [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] forces, against [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[Commander/Legends|commander]] [[Pors Tonith/Legends|Pors Tonith]] and his [[Battle droid/Legends|droid]] army.

==Appearances==
*''[[Jedi Trial]]'' {{1st}}
